title: Smith Normal Form U B V == diag(d_1, ..., d_n) mod q Invariant-Factor Channel Decoupling
claims: For any n x n compressed column matrix B in Z_q^{n x n} with Smith Normal Form U B V == diag(d_1, ..., d_n) (mod q), the unimodular basis changes V and U^{-T} decouple the phase <B v, s> mod q into n independent cyclic channels of orders q_i = q / gcd(d_i, q).
The identifiable secret coset space has exact cardinality prod_{i=1}^n (q / gcd(d_i, q)) and indistinguishable kernel fiber size prod_{i=1}^n gcd(d_i, q).
